title: The Tortoise and the Hare
blurb: The fastest animal in the wood takes a nap. That is his mistake.
script:
[warmly] Long, long ago… in a green wood where the grass grew soft and the streams ran cold, there lived a Hare. [playfully] And oh, this Hare was FAST. He could cross a meadow before the butterflies noticed he was there.

[amused] The trouble was… he knew it. And he told everybody. Every single day.

[grandly] “Watch me!” he would call to the birds. “Nobody in this wood can run like me. Nobody has EVER run like me.”

[gently] The birds were tired of hearing it. The squirrels were tired of hearing it. [short pause] And down at the edge of the pond, moving very slowly through the reeds… so was the Tortoise.

[calmly] One morning the Tortoise lifted his old grey head and said, “I will race you.”

[surprised] The whole wood went quiet.

[laughs] The Hare laughed and laughed. “YOU?” he said. “You take a whole morning to cross a puddle!”

[firmly] “Even so,” said the Tortoise. “I will race you.”

[excited] So a course was marked out, from the old oak tree to the hill at the far end of the meadow. The animals gathered along the path. A crow counted them down… three… two… one…

[quickly] And the Hare was GONE. A brown streak through the grass. By the time the Tortoise had taken four steps, the Hare was halfway to the hill.

[amused] The Hare looked back. He could not even SEE the Tortoise. [thoughtful] And a lazy little thought crawled into his head.

[softly] “I have so much time,” he said. “I shall rest here in the shade… just for a moment.”

[short pause] He lay down under a cool green tree. And the Hare… fell fast asleep.

[gently] Now the Tortoise came along the path. Step. Step. Step. [short pause] He did not stop at the shade. He did not stop at the stream. He did not stop to see how far he had come.

[softly] He passed the sleeping Hare so quietly that not one blade of grass rustled. And he kept on going. Step. Step. Step.

[surprised] When the Hare woke, the sun had moved. He leapt up and ran like the wind — [short pause] but at the top of the hill, the animals were already cheering.

[warmly] The Tortoise was standing at the finish, blinking slowly in the sunshine.

[gently] “How?” said the Hare.

“I never stopped,” said the Tortoise. [warmly] And that is how the slowest animal in the wood won the race.
